title: Activate Trace Online for public pair classification after R2
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. At R2 activate Trace Online for future operations. After each later resolved operation, publish only the pair category safe/corrupted/mixed using the exact locked matrix result; never identify which operator selected what or label alignment. The operation that unlocks R2 is not a future operation. Keep the underlying two inputs private and preserve the semantic event track.repair.trace_online plus persistent board marker.
acceptance: Before R2 and on its unlocking operation no future-operation trace is retroactively disclosed.
Later safe/corrupt/other pairs yield only the canonical aggregate classification, detached from individual choices.
Repeated replay/projection cannot emit the trace twice or expose a private input/role.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
